notes: NUI respec display fix. Companion ability lines now show permanent/base values first; if an active effect changes an ability they display base>current, so buffs/debuffs no longer look like stale respec data. The class-summary cache key now includes current class positions/levels (up to PRC's extended positions), so same-total-level respecs such as Dorna Rogue3/Cleric3 -> Cleric6 cannot reuse the old class string. No combat behavior or spell preparation logic changed. Hidden helpers 0.8.6.31, Dorna 0.8.6.30, somatic 0.8.6.29, companion discipline 0.8.6.28, reader 0.8.6.26, protected combat core 0.7.10.7, familiar FIX5/progression and PRC_MULTISUMMON are unchanged.
